subject: Starting values in model with categorical items

messages.author: e5c4db1a1cffab6b
messages.subject: Starting values in model with categorical items
parts:
Hello

May I please ask you what starting values Lavaan uses in a model with categorical values? For example in a model where the categorical items takes three values: 0,1,2.

What are the starting values for the factor loadings, threshold, and mean and standard deviation of the latent factor used by Lavaan?

Thanks

messages.author: 08e48595b188026f
messages.subject: Re: Starting values in model with categorical items
parts:
Hi,

You can use the lavInspect(fitted.object, what = "start") command to get the starting values.

Regards, Jošt
